problems.problem: The corolla's lower lobe tip escapes below the bottle base (visible in the contact crop at approx x540, y1066-1080 as a mint point under the base line). It collides with the contact shadow and reads as a stray registration artifact, and it vertically crowds the poppy rule at y1097, muddying the calm lower band the brief demands.

The type plaque is bottom-light and internally unbalanced: the tracked GUCCI line (bbox 481-598) and 64px title (bbox 126-947) end at y1278, leaving roughly 162px of dead gentian field below versus only about 150px above the cap, so the plaque floats low instead of sitting as a centered band; the subtitle slot is empty, leaving no mediating line between brand and name as in the reference lockups.

The printed field is optically flat dead color: compared with the references' atmospheric depth (tonal bloom behind the hero), the gentian ink shows no radial value shift, so the mint corolla reads as a pasted vector shape rather than a printed halo owning the light.

changes.value: Seamless flat silkscreen-printed matte card in deep gentian blue with one very soft broad radial lift of value centred slightly above middle, one oversized hard-edge flat scalloped eight-lobed corolla shape in pale mint centred slightly above middle, even shadowless frontal ink illumination, no texture gradients, no objects
